observations: Steal An Egg, Brookhaven, Throw Food For Animals, RIVALS, 99 Nights in the Forest and Murder Mystery 2 lead; the top barely moved today, with one new entry (KRN: Crosshair) and none falling off.
patterns: Higher favorites per thousand visits go with lower positions (rho -0.33), the evergreen effect: big games convert fewer visits into favorites.

outliers.name: Peppa's House (Anomaly)
outliers.note: At 83 days it is the weakest on the pillar even though the Anomaly format is durable elsewhere; likely a licence-parody with weak retention.

observations: Summer Donations, Era Of Witches, Bloodlines, Enter Brainrot and Skyships lead efficiency; Drill City: Chicago is the one new entry.
patterns: Physics sandboxes (loop r=-0.53, Ragdoll keyword r=-0.66) and survival games are the weakest earners per player; combat PvP and story loops are the strongest.

outliers.name: Ragdoll Soccer
outliers.note: Weakest on the pillar at 45 days despite 89 products, a sports ragdoll mix that sells many small items.

observations: BMX Life (+18), Animal Ragdoll (+17), Bibi & Didi Obby (+17) and Break and Steal (+17) were the biggest risers; 12 games entered, among them Crash Engine, Wake Up An Animal and +1 Jutsu Evolution.
patterns: Physics sandboxes may climb more slowly (r=-0.41 within age, Ragdoll keyword r=-0.63); the earlier lead for sandboxes at 74% has reversed.

outliers.name: [❄️SEASON 1 ] BMX LIFE
outliers.note: Best on the pillar despite 70% likes and a bracket tag, which breaks two supposed penalties; a season launch with new bikes is a likely reason.

observations: The Great Build, an official Roblox event, is #1 at 3 days, followed by untitled monkey game, Crash Engine, Barber Empire and Draw Your Cart.
patterns: Updates per week (rho +0.35), novelty (+0.24) and visits (+0.24) lead; bracket tags, long titles and caps-heavy titles may rank lower.

outliers.name: Draw Your Cart!
outliers.note: At 32% likes it still sits at #5, so a curiosity hook plus new-game boost can outweigh reception for a few weeks.

summary: No video frames were available today (four videos were queued without frames) and no new research; 60 games were profiled.
Visits and favorites help on all four charts, but they are partly results of success; novelty and updates per week help on both young charts.
progressions: Chart-to-chart entries: uc→tt 362 (median 2 days), tt→mp 255 (2 days), uc→te 221 (5 days), uc→mp 189 (4 days).
